name: qsmxt-bids
label: QSMxT
description: Runs Neurodesk QSMxT 9.x on an XNAT MR session. The session's DICOM scans are mounted directly and QSMxT converts them to BIDS internally (qsmxt dicom-convert) before running the QSM pipeline, so no pre-existing NIFTI or BIDS scan resources are required.

inputs.name: premade
inputs.label: Premade pipeline
inputs.description: QSMxT pipeline preset, mapped onto QSMxT 9.x algorithm flags. Supported values: default, gre, epi, bet, fast, body, nextqsm.

outputs.name: qsmxt-output
outputs.description: QSMxT derivatives copied from the BIDS derivatives directory (derivatives/qsmxt/).

xnat.name: qsmxt-session
xnat.label: QSMxT
xnat.description: Run QSMxT on this MR session

external-inputs.name: session
external-inputs.description: Input MR session. Its DICOM scans are converted to BIDS inside the QSMxT container, so no pre-existing NIFTI/BIDS scan resources are needed. The session should contain multi-echo GRE (part-mag/part-phase) QSM series.
